QuestInfo.name: Sending Provisions (1)
QuestInfo.0: There may be a way to help supply the Mushking's soldiers. #b#p1300005##k has a secret to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: Eliminate #r#o3300003##k, obtain #b25 #t4000502##k. Turn them in to the #b#p1300005##k.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered and delivered the #b#t4000502#s#k to #b#p1300005##k in order to contribute to the supply.
QuestInfo.summary: Eliminate #r#o3300003##k, obtain #b25 #t4000502##k. Turn them in to the #b#p1300005##k.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 5,000\nCan proceed to the Sending Provisions (2) quest\n

0.0: Before you enter the castle, I have a request. The rush to escape this temporary base has left us without supplies. My soldiers are still guarding the area, but they won't last long without something to eat! Can you help?

yes.0: Your help will mean more than you'll ever know! The supplies won't be easy to come by, but 25 #b#t4000502#s would give us the raw material for a great set of new helmets. I've seen a #r#o3300003##k wear a #b#t4000502##k before, maybe you can get some from #b#m106020700##k.

no.0: That's too bad. This may not seem important to you, but it is to us. I hope you'll reconsider.

1.0: Yes! We'll have protected heads in no time!

yes.0: Thanks! I hate to say it, but this just isn't going to be enough for all of our soldiers! How did things get this bad? Adventurer, please eliminate #b#p1300001##k for us!

item.0: Thank you again for your help, but we need more! Please bring me #b25 #t4000502#s#k from #b#m106020700##k. #r#o3300003#s#k should drop them!
